scope: All 439 active routines, including optional/AUX initializers; conservative superset of runtime reachability. No constant-folding or indirect-call exclusion.

primitiveContracts.contract: Signed 16-bit arithmetic; wrap results; / truncates toward zero; MOD has dividend sign. Zero divisor errors. Unary - negates.
Bitwise AND/OR on 16-bit patterns; return the resulting word.
Return 1 iff every bit of the second operand occurs in the first; otherwise 0.
Predicates return 0/1. Equality compares patterns (EQUAL? supports alternative operands); N==? negates equality; ordering is signed. NOT/0?/ZERO? test zero; 1? tests one.
First operand designates a variable, not its value. Increment/decrement with wrap, store, then compare signed against the evaluated bound; return 0/1.
SET writes a named local; SETG a named global. Both return the assigned word. VALUE reads the variable whose numeric variable number is supplied (global slots start at 16). Invalid references error.

Left-to-right short-circuit control flow. COND returns its selected last expression, or test value for an empty body, or 0 if none. AND returns 0 on failure, otherwise last value; OR returns first nonzero, otherwise 0.

Block bindings are lexical and initialized in order. PROG runs once; REPEAT repeats. RETURN exits the nearest enclosing PROG/REPEAT, or routine if none, with value (default 1); AGAIN restarts that activation. Routine fallthrough returns the final expression. Empty statement block returns 1.

RTRUE/RFALSE return from the routine with 1/0 across all nested blocks. PUSH adds a word to this frame operand stack; RSTACK pops and returns from the routine. Underflow errors. RFATAL expands to PUSH 2/RSTACK.
Evaluate routine word and arguments once in order; call that routine; zero routine returns zero. Ordinary named routine calls use the same frame/default/return rules.

Read parent/first child/next sibling or test immediate parent. MOVE detaches then inserts first under destination; REMOVE detaches. Mutators are statement operations with value 1 in value position; invalid objects and tree cycles error.
Set/clear/test reference-numbered attribute, 0..31. Test returns 0/1; mutation returns 1 in value position.

Reference-numbered properties in descending order. Missing GETP uses defaults; GETPT missing returns 0; PTSIZE 0 returns 0. GETP reads byte or first word; PUTP requires an existing 1/2-byte property and returns 1. NEXTP obj 0 returns first property; otherwise next, or 0 at end.

GET/PUT use byte address + 2*index, GETB/PUTB address + index. Words big-endian, byte writes use low 8 bits; writes return 1. REST/BACK add/subtract byte count (REST defaults to one byte when omitted, SRC-010); address overflow or access outside a declared segment errors. Interior pointers retain identity. Shared boundary addresses select a fitting allocation containing the base in its closed pointer range; accesses never straddle allocations or dereference padding (SRC-012).

Print string reference/inline literal/dictionary word/ZSCII character/object short name/signed number/newline. Each yields 1 when a value is required. Physical source newlines fold to spaces, except a formatting newline immediately after | is suppressed; | emits a newline. Preserve other spacing. PRINTD reads mutable encoded short-name bytes.
Positive signed bound draws 1..n; negative reseeds with -n and returns 0; zero deterministically reseeds per compatibility policy and returns 0. Replay validates every range and draw position.

Suspend in an explicit serializable continuation. READ fills V3 buffers then resumes. SAVE captures its success continuation; RESTORE success replaces the current continuation with the saved one. Failures resume false. Restart invokes fresh GO; quit is terminal.
Return true only for a validated complete semantic bundle. This replaces the original story checksum check; never pretend an invalid bundle verified.
Compiled debug stream verbs only; not exposed as options. Reaching either fails explicitly as unsupported host stream selection; no silent no-op.

scratchExclusions.reason: Typed noun/clause scanning and ambiguity scratch; option identity supplies explicit operands. Helper preconditions and parser-return assertions test any retained use.
Orphan merging, reserve input and AGAIN are replaced; adapter initializes unsupported modes to zero, except directional AGAIN-DIR which is checked in parser fixtures.
Scratch of retained LIT?/DO-SL/search helpers. Check helper effects independently; do not call these helpers from pure queries.
